'''''Diplachne fusca''''', called '''bearded sprangletop''' and '''Kallar grass''', is a widespread species of [[Poaceae|grass]] in the genus ''[[Diplachne]]'', native to North America, the [[Caribbean]], South America, Africa, Asia, and [[Australia]], and introduced in Europe, New Zealand and [[Hawaii]], among other places.<ref name="60458632-2" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:60458632-2 |title=''Diplachne fusca'' (L.) P.Beauv. ex Roem. & Schult. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=27 December 2020 }}</ref><ref>{{citation|journal=[[PhytoKeys]]| date=January 25, 2018|issue=93|doi=10.3897/phytokeys.93.21079|title=Monograph of Diplachne (Poaceae, Chloridoideae, Cynodonteae)|author1-first=Neil |author1-last=Snow |author2-first=Paul M |author2-last=Peterson |author3-first=Konstantin |author3-last=Romaschenko|author4-first= Bryan K |author4-last=Simon| pages=1–102| doi-access=free| pmid=29416413| pmc=5799776| bibcode=2018PhytK..93....1S}}</ref> It prefers to live in salty, wet conditions, such as in salt [[Marsh|marshes]] and shallow depressions.<ref>{{cite book |title=CRC World Dictionary of Grasses: Common Names, Scientific Names, Eponyms, Synonyms, and Etymology |last1=Quattrocchi |first1=Umberto |date=26 April 2006 |publisher=CRC Press |page=1202 |isbn=978-0-8493-1303-5 }}</ref>

==Subspecies==
The following subspecies are currently accepted:<ref name = "60458632-2" />

*''Diplachne fusca'' subsp. ''fascicularis'' <small>(Lam.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow</small>
*''Diplachne fusca'' subsp. ''fusca''
*''Diplachne fusca'' subsp. ''muelleri'' <small>(Benth.) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow</small>
*''Diplachne fusca'' subsp. ''uninervia'' <small>(J.Presl) P.M.Peterson & N.Snow</small>
